faq.q: Does this generate a .ico file for my website?
faq.a: No — the tool is explicit that a true multi-resolution .ico can't be built reliably in the browser. It outputs PNG favicons, which every modern browser supports via <link rel="icon" type="image/png">. If you need an .ico fallback for very old browsers, take the 32×32 PNG to a dedicated ICO converter. The generated HTML snippet already declares the PNG icons.

faq.q: What sizes and files are in the ZIP download?
faq.a: The 'Download Full Package' ZIP contains PNGs at 16, 32, 48, 64, 96, 128, 150, 180, 192 and 512 pixels, with 180 named apple-touch-icon.png and 150 named mstile-150x150.png. It also includes a ready-to-paste favicon-links.html snippet and a site.webmanifest declaring the 192 and 512 icons plus an 'any maskable' entry.

faq.q: Can I make a favicon from a logo rather than text?
faq.a: Yes. Switch to Image Upload mode and drop a logo or photo. You get a square crop with zoom and horizontal/vertical position sliders, an option to fill transparent areas with a chosen colour, a 'trim transparent padding' option that auto-detects the non-transparent bounding box, and square/rounded/circle shapes. There's also a Text/Initials mode and an Emoji mode.

faq.q: How do I check my favicon won't disappear on a dark browser tab?
faq.a: Use the Live Preview section, which shows your icon in a browser tab, bookmark bar, iOS home screen and Android launcher context. Tick the 'Dark-mode preview' checkbox to repaint those mockups with dark backgrounds, so you can confirm a dark icon doesn't vanish against a dark tab bar before you ship it.
